lastCompletedStory.title: Replace blocking poll loop with pure stepMergeWatch tick

nextStoryContext: stepMergeWatch is now exported from src/release/merge-watch.ts. MergeWatchState has optional pollCount and lastPolledAt fields. runMergeWatch still exists (caller: sidecar.ts) and uses a virtual clock internally. The next story (US-002) likely wires stepMergeWatch into the sidecar idle tick with real state persistence to .claude/.cam-merge-watch.json.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-001 is a pure TypeScript state machine refactor with no external library surface (gh pollFn is injected and abstracted away).
